name: Whack-a-Role
author: Zyrain
bootlegger: For all rules including end-game conditions, notifications, and nominations, treat travelers as regular players.
If a demon dies, a minion can become the demon (Hindu optional rule).
A traveler death can trigger the Hindu.
A player can trigger the Hindu more than once.
Only daytime Hindu changes are public, but which traveler they become is not announced.
A traveler that dies and becomes the same traveler isn't told they died.
